title: [Autour de La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois, pages 1 à 67] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context: section 1, 'Résultats de fidélité', at the start of the 'Longue Marche' notes. These notes prepare anabelian statements, namely that K ↦ Π_K is faithful and conservative on suitable categories of fields. The previous page attaches to each field K its étale topos B_K, a profinite Galois topos. Its groupoid of points Π_K is anti-equivalent to the category of separable closures of K. Each automorphism group E_{K̄/K} = Gal(K̄/K) is (the opposite of) the automorphism group of the corresponding point, and B_K is recovered as continuous discrete Gal-sets.

This page states the functoriality.
- A field homomorphism K → K' is a morphism of schemes Spec K' → Spec K.
- It gives a morphism of topoi (1) B_{K'} → B_K.
- Equivalently it gives a morphism of fundamental groupoids (2) Π_{K'} → Π_K. On objects, a separable closure K̄' of K' (a point, or universal cover, of B_{K'}) is sent to K̄, the separable closure of K inside K̄'.
- For corresponding base points this gives a homomorphism of fundamental groups (3) Gal(K̄'/K') → Gal(K̄/K), namely restriction σ ↦ σ|_{K̄}.
- The topos morphism is recovered from (3) as 'restriction of scalars': a continuous Gal(K̄/K)-set is viewed as a Gal(K̄'/K')-set via (3).

The page then begins the computation of the image of (3), finished on the next page. The image is the closed subgroup Gal(K̄/K_1), where K_1 = K̄ ∩ K' is the separable algebraic closure of K in K'. If K' is finitely generated over K, then K_1 is finite over K, so the image has finite index. The map is onto iff K is separably closed in K'. It is injective iff K' is algebraic over K, and bijective iff K'/K is purely inseparable (radicielle). In characteristic 0 this yields conservativity of K ↦ Π_K on finitely generated extensions. All of this is standard Galois theory, phrased in the topos/groupoid language of SGA1/SGA4.
errors: The image corresponds to the separable algebraic closure of K in K' (equal to K̄ ∩ K'). The next page's correction 'clôture alg.' in place of 'sép.' is only harmless in characteristic 0, which Grothendieck then restricts to.

ideas.what: Functoriality of the étale topos / fundamental groupoid of a field under field extensions; a morphism of topoi corresponds to a morphism of profinite groupoids, recovered by restriction of scalars along the Galois group map.
ideas.modern_name: Functoriality of étale fundamental groupoid; equivalence between pointed connected Galois topoi and profinite groups (Galois categories)

ideas.what: Image of the restriction map Gal(K̄'/K') → Gal(K̄/K) is Gal(K̄/(K̄∩K')).
ideas.modern_name: Restriction map of absolute Galois groups / natural irrationalities
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical Galois theory (Krull for infinite case)

deep.surprise_reason: This is a routine setup page: functoriality of the Galois topos of a field and the image of the restriction map. It is preparatory to anabelian fidelity statements but contains nothing beyond standard material.
transcription_corrections: The subscript written as K with a star-like mark in 'Π_{K*}', 'K̄*' and 'E_{K̄*/K*}' is just K (the base field), consistent with the transcription.
The superscript added above 'clôture sép.' reads K̄' (the separable closure of K'), consistent with the transcription.
